_schema: off-market-deal-finder class scoring v2.0. See references/pipeline-contract.md Section 11 for the band schema and references/scoring/shared_adjustments.json for multipliers, tiers, caps and suppressions. Weights sum to 100.

factors.name: capital_stack_timing

bands.reading: Balloon inside a year; the owner is already talking to lenders or brokers.
bands.lever: Certainty of close before maturity; assumption if agency/HUD.

bands.reading: Refinance planning window; the owner knows the rate shock is coming.
On the horizon; not yet urgent.
Monitor only.
Same as LOAN_MATURITY for ex-regulated or mixed assets.
As above.
Past maturity; every month is borrowed time from the servicer.

modifiers.reading: Floating-rate debt with cap replacement cost and extension tests.
modifiers.lever: Offer the exit the extension test may deny.

modifiers.reading: Bought at peak pricing with SOFR+300-450 bridge debt; the most motivated market-rate cohort.
modifiers.lever: Recap or sale before final maturity.

modifiers.reading: Yield maintenance or lockout burning off; sale and cash-out refi become economic.
modifiers.lever: Contact 3-6 months before the open date.

modifiers.reading: Coupon far below market; refi proceeds shrink sharply.
modifiers.lever: If assumable, the low coupon is your edge; tag assumption_play.

factors.notes: Base points from the nearest DEBT event; modifiers additive; cap 25; then basis multiplier of the governing event.

bands.reading: Owner must inject 25%+ of the balance to refinance at par.
bands.lever: Sale or recap is the only path; model it for them.

bands.reading: Partial paydown required; painful but possible.
Refinanceable with friction.
Refinanceable; maturity alone is a weak seller signal.

modifiers.reading: Property cannot cover debt service at today's rates.
Bridge extension test fails; forced sale or recap likely.

post_multipliers.description: x1.0 reported DSCR/NOI (tape or user-supplied), x0.7 benchmark estimate (shared_adjustments.noi_source_weight)
x1.0 if first_debt_months_out < 24, x0.5 if 24-60, x0 if no DEBT event inside horizon

bands.reading: Default or imminent default; special servicer controls the workout.
bands.lever: Register with the special servicer; owner outreach may be moot.

bands.reading: Non-performing matured balloon.
bands.lever: Note sale or DPO conversation with the servicer.

bands.reading: Lender elected to sell; 120-day clock running.
bands.lever: First 45 days: owner still controls the outcome.

bands.reading: Heading to sale without rescission.
bands.lever: Lender-consent paths; prepare for REO track.

bands.reading: Court-appointed receiver operates the asset; owner equity likely impaired.
bands.lever: Route lender_counterparty; register as qualified buyer within 30 days.

bands.reading: Commercial lender preserving deficiency/guaranty via ORS 88; 6-12 months to judgment.
bands.lever: First 90 days, before a receiver or bankruptcy strategy locks in.

bands.reading: Title-affecting suit recorded.
bands.lever: Pull the complaint; identify the liquidity-seeking party.

bands.reading: Stalling foreclosure; plan or 363 sale within 90-180 days.
Performing but past maturity; extension or forced sale pending.
Mezz lender about to take the owning entity.
Three years of unpaid taxes on an apartment is not an oversight.
Extension already negotiated; 1-2 years of runway then forced resolution.
Stalled renovation with a 120-day clock now in court.
bands.lever: Failed value-add plan; buy the project.

bands.reading: Servicer trigger hit (DSCR, occupancy, maturity).

modifiers.reading: Personal exposure raises willingness to cooperate on a short sale or assumption.
Hidden leverage above the recorded first; total LTV 10-20 points higher than it looks.
modifiers.lever: Raise est_ltv; expect a harder refi.

bands.reading: Partners deadlocked or winding up; the asset must be sold or bought out.
bands.lever: All-cash certainty to both sides; expect court approval.

bands.reading: Portfolio-level maturity wall; healthy assets get sold to raise liquidity.
bands.lever: Approach on the healthy asset, not the sick one.

bands.reading: Estate of the principal; heirs rarely want to run apartments.
Owner entity inactive over a year; neglect, death or dispute.
bands.lever: Patient buyer who can wait for reinstatement.

bands.reading: Missed annual report; could be clerical.
Entity formed at acquisition with a bank balloon now past typical term.
No shelter left; full recapture on sale; estate-planning stage.
bands.lever: 1031, DST, UPREIT, installment or seller carry, not price.

bands.reading: Trust-held; successor trustees often prefer liquidity.
Distant or non-Pacific foreign LLC; Oregon's regulatory load is a reason to exit.
Out-of-state sponsor.
Operational reset or pre-sale cleanup.

modifiers.reading: Sponsor family just sold another asset; consolidating or exiting.
modifiers.lever: Ask about the rest of the portfolio.

bands.reading: Three years delinquent.
City referred liens to foreclosure; narrow redemption window.
Two years delinquent; stress visible, county not yet involved.
Deferred maintenance with escalating fees.
Tried to sell, missed price; exclusive may have lapsed.
bands.lever: Confirm the exclusive ended; use last ask as a ceiling.

bands.reading: Cannot bind compliant coverage; blocks refinance.
bands.lever: Buyer with a program in place.

bands.reading: Below-market rents the owner cannot close faster than the state cap.
bands.lever: Value-add buyer pays for the gap.

bands.reading: One missed installment.
Withdrawn 6-12 months ago; owner re-anchoring.
Repeatedly cited landlord spending on defense.
One open case.

modifiers.lever: Relocation exposure is a line in your underwriting and their fatigue.

factors.name: signal_stacking

bands.reading: Two independent records.
Three independent records.
Converging distress.

factors.notes: Events older than 180 days count 50% except permanent states (shared_adjustments.decay).

routes.condition: sponsor_loans_maturing_36mo >= 3 requires >= 2 independent indicators across the sponsor family before scoring; apply to every asset of the family

quality_rules: No DEBT and no REGULATORY event inside horizon -> tier cap C (shared_adjustments.caps.no_debt_no_reg_mf).
Insurance non-renewal is scored only when confirmed; never inferred from geography.
A recorded Modification/Extension or Reconveyance re-opens the maturity question: re-derive before scoring timing.
